def field.reduce_u64 (x : Std.U64) : Result Std.U32 := do

  let i2 ← x >>> 31#u32

  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 field.P)
  let i4 ← lift (x1 &&& i3)
  let i5 ← x1 >>> 31#u32
  let x2 ← i4 + i5
  let x3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 x2)
  if x3 >= field.P
  then x3 - field.P
  else ok x3

def field.CM31.inv_with
  (self : field.CM31) (inverse : field.M31 → Result field.M31) :
  Result field.CM31
  := do
  let m ← field.M31.mul self.a self.a
  let m1 ← field.M31.mul self.b self.b
  let norm ← field.M31.add m m1
  let inv_norm ← inverse norm
  let m2 ← field.M31.mul self.a inv_norm
  let m3 ← field.M31.neg self.b
  let m4 ← field.M31.mul m3 inv_norm
  ok { a := m2, b := m4 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::r23_product_u32_bounded]:
    Source: 'src/r23_width.rs', lines 5:0-11:1
    Visibility: public -/
def field.r23_product_u32_bounded
  (left : Std.U64) (right : Std.U64) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from core.num.U32.MAX)
  if left <= i
  then
    let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from core.num.U32.MAX)
    if right <= i1
    then
      let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 left)
      let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
      let i4 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 right)
      let i5 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i4)
      i3 * i5
    else left * right
  else left * right

def field.CM31.square (self : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  let i := self.a
  let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i4 ← i1 + i3
  let i5 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from field.P)
  let i7 ← i5 + i6
  let i8 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i9 ← i7 - i8
  let i10 ← field.r23_product_u32_bounded i4 i9
  let m ← field.M31.reduce_u64 i10
  let m1 ← field.M31.mul self.a self.b
  let m2 ← field.M31.double m1
  ok { a := m, b := m2 }

  (self : field.CM31) (rhs : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do

  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)

  let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i5)

  let i8 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i7)
  let i9 ← i6 + i8
  let i10 ← field.r23_product_u32_bounded i4 i9
  let m2 ← field.M31.reduce_u64 i10
  let m ← field.M31.sub m0 m1
  let m3 ← field.M31.sub m2 m0
  let m4 ← field.M31.sub m3 m1
  ok { a := m, b := m4 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::try_inv]:
    Source: 'src/field.rs', lines 930:4-940:5
    Visibility: public -/
def field.QM31.try_inv (self : field.QM31) : Result (Option field.QM31) := do
  let b ← field.QM31.is_zero self
  if b
  then ok none
  else
    let c ← field.CM31.square self.c0
    let c1 ← field.CM31.square self.c1
    let c2 ← field.mul_by_r c1
    let norm ← field.CM31.sub c c2
    let inverse_norm ← field.CM31.inv norm
    let c3 ← field.CM31.mul self.c0 inverse_norm
    let c4 ← field.CM31.neg self.c1
    let c5 ← field.CM31.mul c4 inverse_norm
    ok (some { c0 := c3, c1 := c5 })

def field.QM31.square (self : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let c0_square ← field.CM31.square self.c0
  let c1_square ← field.CM31.square self.c1
  let c ← field.mul_by_r c1_square
  let c1 ← field.CM31.add c0_square c
  let c2 ← field.CM31.mul self.c0 self.c1
  let c3 ← field.CM31.double c2
  ok { c0 := c1, c1 := c3 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::mul]:
    Source: 'src/field.rs', lines 868:4-877:5
    Visibility: public -/
def field.QM31.mul
  (self : field.QM31) (rhs : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let o ← field.r24_canonical_mul self rhs
  match o with
  | none =>
    let m0 ← field.CM31.mul self.c0 rhs.c0
    let m1 ← field.CM31.mul self.c1 rhs.c1
    let c ← field.CM31.add self.c0 self.c1
    let c1 ← field.CM31.add rhs.c0 rhs.c1
    let m2 ← field.CM31.mul c c1
    let c2 ← field.mul_by_r m1
    let c3 ← field.CM31.add m0 c2
    let c4 ← field.CM31.sub m2 m0
    let c5 ← field.CM31.sub c4 m1
    ok { c0 := c3, c1 := c5 }
  | some result => ok result

/-- [aspis_core::circle::secure_circle_point_from_parameter]:
    Source: 'src/circle.rs', lines 34:0-46:1
    Visibility: public -/
def circle.secure_circle_point_from_parameter
  (parameter1 : field.QM31) :
  Result (core.result.Result circle.SecureCirclePoint circle.CirclePointError)
  := do
  let square ← field.QM31.square parameter1
  let q ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ONE square
  let o ← field.QM31.try_inv q
  let r ←
    core.option.Option.ok_or o circle.CirclePointError.SingularParameter
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let q1 ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE square
    let q2 ← field.QM31.mul q1 val
    let q3 ← field.QM31.add parameter1 parameter1
    let q4 ← field.QM31.mul q3 val
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok { x := q2, y := q4 })
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame circle.CirclePointError)
      residual

  (self : field.CM31) (other : field.CM31) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.eq self.a other.a
  if b
  then field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.eq self.b other.b
  else ok false

/-- [aspis_core::circle::secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter]:
    Source: 'src/circle.rs', lines 55:0-65:1
    Visibility: public -/
def circle.secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter
  (parameter1 : field.QM31) :
  Result (core.result.Result circle.SecureCirclePoint circle.CirclePointError)
  := do
  let r ← circle.secure_circle_point_from_parameter parameter1
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let b ←
      field.CM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqCM31.eq parameter1.c1 field.CM31.ZERO
    if b
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        circle.CirclePointError.ParameterInCm31Subfield)
    else ok (core.result.Result.Ok val)
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame circle.CirclePointError)
      residual

/-- [aspis_core::transcript::DOM_SQUEEZE]
    Source: 'src/transcript.rs', lines 243:0-243:29 -/
@[global_simps, irreducible] def transcript.DOM_SQUEEZE : Std.U8 := 1#u8

/-- [aspis_core::transcript::{aspis_core::transcript::Transcript}::squeeze_block]:
    Source: 'src/transcript.rs', lines 350:4-358:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.squeeze_block
  (self : transcript.Transcript) :
  Result ((Array Std.U8 32#usize) × transcript.Transcript)
  := do
  let squeeze := Array.repeat 33#usize 0#u8
  let (s, index_mut_back) ←
    core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8)) squeeze
      { «end» := 32#usize }
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice self.state)
  let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
  let squeeze1 := index_mut_back s2
  let squeeze2 ← Array.update squeeze1 32#usize transcript.DOM_SQUEEZE
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice squeeze2)
  let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ s3 ]))
  let out ← self.hash s4
  let squeeze3 ← Array.update squeeze2 32#usize transcript.DOM_ADVANCE
  let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice squeeze3)
  let s6 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ s5 ]))
  let a ← self.hash s6
  ok (out, { self with state := a })

    Visibility: public -/
@[global_simps, irreducible]
def transcript.CHALLENGE_RETRY_LIMIT : Std.U32 := 8#u32

/-- [aspis_core::transcript::{aspis_core::transcript::Transcript}::challenge_qm31]: loop body 1:
    Source: 'src/transcript.rs', lines 384:12-401:13
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def transcript.Transcript.challenge_qm31_loop0_loop0.body
  (limb : field.M31) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.U32)
  (self : transcript.Transcript) (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (word_index : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.U32) × transcript.Transcript
    × (Array Std.U8 32#usize) × Std.Usize) (transcript.Transcript × (Array
    Std.U8 32#usize) × Std.Usize × field.M31 × Bool))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepU32 iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (self, block, word_index, limb, false))
  | some _ =>
    let (self1, block1, word_index1) ←
      if word_index = 8#usize
      then
        do
        let (block2, self2) ← transcript.Transcript.squeeze_block self
        ok (self2, block2, 0#usize)
      else ok (self, block, word_index)
    let i ← word_index1 * 4#usize
    let i1 ← i + 4#usize
    let s ←
      core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) block1
        { start := i, «end» := i1 }
    let r ←
      core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 4#usize core.marker.CopyU8 s
    let a ← core.result.Result.unwrap core.fmt.DebugTryFromSliceError r
    let word ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes a)
    let word_index2 ← word_index1 + 1#usize
    let masked ← lift (word &&& field.P)
    if masked != field.P
    then ok (done (self1, block1, word_index2, masked, true))
    else ok (cont (iter1, self1, block1, word_index2))

def transcript.Transcript.challenge_qm31_loop0.body
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut field.M31)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut field.M31 → core.slice.iter.IterMut
  field.M31) (self : transcript.Transcript) (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (word_index : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.slice.iter.IterMut field.M31) ×
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut field.M31 → core.slice.iter.IterMut field.M31)
    × transcript.Transcript × (Array Std.U8 32#usize) × Std.Usize)
    (transcript.Transcript × (Option (core.result.Result field.QM31
    transcript.ChallengeSampleExhausted)) × (core.slice.iter.IterMut
    field.M31)))
  := do
  let (o, iter1, next_back) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (self, none, let im := next_back iter1 none
                                  back im))
  | some limb =>
    let (self1, block1, word_index1, limb1, accepted) ←
      transcript.Transcript.challenge_qm31_loop0_loop0
        { start := 0#u32, «end» := transcript.CHALLENGE_RETRY_LIMIT } self
        block word_index limb
    if accepted
    then
      ok (cont (iter1, fun im => let im1 := next_back im (some limb1)
                                 back im1, self1, block1, word_index1))
    else
      ok (done (self1, some (core.result.Result.Err ()),
        let im := next_back iter1 (some limb1)
        back im))

/-- [aspis_core::transcript::{aspis_core::transcript::Transcript}::challenge_qm31]:
    Source: 'src/transcript.rs', lines 378:4-416:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.challenge_qm31
  (self : transcript.Transcript) :
  Result ((core.result.Result field.QM31 transcript.ChallengeSampleExhausted)
    × transcript.Transcript)
  := do
  let limbs := Array.repeat 4#usize field.M31.ZERO
  let (block, self1) ← transcript.Transcript.squeeze_block self
  let (s, to_slice_mut_back) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut limbs)
  let (iter, iter_mut_back) ← core.slice.Slice.iter_mut s
  let (self2, pending_return, back) ←
    transcript.Transcript.challenge_qm31_loop0 iter (fun im => im) self1 block
      0#usize
  match pending_return with
  | none =>
    let s1 := iter_mut_back back
    let limbs1 := to_slice_mut_back s1
    let m ← Array.index_usize limbs1 0#usize
    let m1 ← Array.index_usize limbs1 1#usize
    let m2 ← Array.index_usize limbs1 2#usize
    let m3 ← Array.index_usize limbs1 3#usize
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok
      { c0 := { a := m, b := m1 }, c1 := { a := m2, b := m3 } }, self2)
  | some r => ok (r, self2)

/-- [aspis_core::transcript::{aspis_core::transcript::Transcript}::challenge_secure_circle_point]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'src/transcript.rs', lines 456:8-465:5
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def transcript.Transcript.challenge_secure_circle_point_loop.body
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.U32) (self : transcript.Transcript) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.U32) × transcript.Transcript)
    ((core.result.Result circle.SecureCirclePoint
    transcript.CirclePointSampleError) × transcript.Transcript))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepU32 iter
  match o with
  | none =>
    ok (done (core.result.Result.Err
      transcript.CirclePointSampleError.ParameterSampleExhausted, self))
  | some _ =>
    let (r, self1) ← transcript.Transcript.challenge_qm31 self
    let r1 ←
      core.result.Result.map_err
        transcript.Transcript.challenge_secure_circle_point.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleChallengeSampleExhaustedCirclePointSampleError
        r ()
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let r2 ← circle.secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter val
      match r2 with
      | core.result.Result.Ok point =>
        ok (done (core.result.Result.Ok point, self1))
      | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (cont (iter1, self1))
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let return_capture ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame
          transcript.CirclePointSampleError) residual
      ok (done (return_capture, self1))

  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.U32) (self : transcript.Transcript) :

  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, self1) =>
      transcript.Transcript.challenge_secure_circle_point_loop.body iter1
      self1)
    (iter, self)
